title: Plan and run reversible engine automation
description: A reversible, evidence-producing workflow for plan and run reversible engine automation.

ordered_stages.action: Read engine version, project state, existing MCP configuration, and repository status.
Describe exact files, editor operations, permissions, backups, health checks, and rollback.
Require the human-confirmed plan digest before editor control or configuration mutation.
Apply only scoped actions through one MCP server for the host application.
Run editor health checks, tests, screenshots, and rollback rehearsal.

quality_gates.description: Verify rights, consent, code, weights, datasets, output terms, and generation provenance.
Validate formats and domain-specific technical constraints.
Check visual identity and temporal consistency across relevant views and frames.
Check memory, frame time, draw calls, load time, and asset budgets.
Run interaction and playability smoke tests in the target runtime.
Store screenshots, artifacts, logs, versions, and comparison evidence.
Require human approval before replacing any source or production asset.
No mutation occurs before digest confirmation.
Only one active MCP server controls a given host application.

fallbacks: Provide manual editor steps when no compatible MCP is available.
Disable the pack and restore backed-up configuration if health checks fail.
